palette.description: Search and jump to any area

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Move around Turing without leaving the keyboard.
shortcuts.dismiss: Close the palette or a dialog

activate.title: Turn on AI
activate.subtitle: Turing needs a language model before chat, retrieval, agents and semantic navigation can answer anything. Pick either way in — both work the same afterwards.

managed.title: Activate Viglet AI
managed.body: Pair this install in one click and start with a free managed model. No account, no card, no keys.

byok.title: Use my own API key
byok.body: Point Turing at OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, a local Ollama — anything you already run. Free and fully featured.

activate.disclosure: Viglet AI runs on Viglet's endpoint: prompts and retrieved content leave this install. Your own API key keeps that traffic between you and your provider.
activate.noLlmDescription: No model is configured yet, so there is nothing for this screen to ask. Choose either way in and come straight back.
activate.noLlmAgents: Agents can be authored now, but none of them can answer until a model is configured.
activate.noLlmSkills: Skills can be authored now, but none of them can run until a model is configured.
activate.noLlmSn: These settings can be saved now, but this site cannot answer a question until a model is configured.
activate.instructions: Open the page below, sign in, and enter this code to approve this install.
activate.doneBody: Chat, retrieval, agents and semantic navigation are ready. You can switch to your own API key at any time.
activate.startError: Could not reach Viglet AI to start the activation.
activate.pollError: Lost contact with Viglet AI while waiting for approval.

activate.title: Turn on AI first
activate.body: Turing ships without a language model, so chat, retrieval and agents stay quiet until you give it one. On the home screen, activate the free managed Viglet AI or paste your own API key — both work the same afterwards.

rail.title: One rail, three hubs
rail.body: The left rail keeps just Home and the three hubs — Generative AI, Enterprise Search, and Management. Everything else lives one tap inside its hub.

palette.title: Jump anywhere with the palette
palette.body: Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) from any screen to search and jump straight to any area. Press ? any time to see every shortcut.

customize.title: Make it yours
customize.body: On any list, Customize layout lets you drag tiles to reorder them and pick their size. Your arrangement sticks across sessions.

layout.editHint: Drag tiles to reorder · pick S / M / L to resize
